title: S1 · Lógica de entrega (Registry, Factory, PlayerData, Rewards, DeliveryService)
request: Sprint 1, comandos 5+6/8 fusionados (Plan §6): DestinationRegistry, PackageFactory, PlayerData, RewardService y DeliveryService (FSM por jugador, timer 60 s, prompts, paquete visible, colisiones por velocidad de impacto). Se fusionan porque DeliveryService requiere los demás módulos al arrancar: entregarlos por separado dejaría el juego roto entre ejecuciones. Ejecutar DESPUÉS de cmd_000023.

operations.source:
-- DestinationRegistry · Resuelve destinos: datos (Data.Destinations) + marcador
-- físico en Workspace.Delivery60.Destinations llamado "<id>_Marker" (cmd_000022).
-- Plan §9-3: las bandas de tiempo se MEDIRÁN sobre la ciudad real en el playtest.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Data = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Delivery60"):WaitForChild("Data")
local DestinationsData = require(Data:WaitForChild("Destinations"))

local DestinationRegistry = {}

function DestinationRegistry.Get(destinationId)
	return DestinationsData[destinationId]
end

function DestinationRegistry.GetMarker(destinationId)
	local root = workspace:FindFirstChild("Delivery60")
	local folder = root and root:FindFirstChild("Destinations")
	if not folder then
		return nil
	end
	return folder:FindFirstChild(destinationId .. "_Marker")
end

function DestinationRegistry.ListIds()
	local ids = {}
	for id in pairs(DestinationsData) do
		table.insert(ids, id)
	end
	return ids
end

function DestinationRegistry.RandomId(rng)
	local ids = DestinationRegistry.ListIds()
	return ids[rng:NextInteger(1, #ids)]
end

return DestinationRegistry

-- PackageFactory · Genera paquetes: tipo + modificadores + destino (Plan §4).
-- S1: aleatorio simple entre los 3 tipos del MVP (Normal/Heavy/Explosive).
-- Los conflictos entre modificadores se resuelven con ModifierRunner.ResolveList (§9-1).
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Root = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Delivery60")
local PackageTypes = require(Root.Data:WaitForChild("PackageTypes"))

local Modules = script.Parent
local ModifierRunner = require(Modules:WaitForChild("ModifierRunner"))
local DestinationRegistry = require(Modules:WaitForChild("DestinationRegistry"))

local PackageFactory = {}
local nextId = 1

function PackageFactory.Create(rng)
	local typeIds = {}
	for id in pairs(PackageTypes) do
		table.insert(typeIds, id)
	end
	local typeId = typeIds[rng:NextInteger(1, #typeIds)]
	local packageType = PackageTypes[typeId]

	local delivery = {
		id = nextId,
		packageType = typeId,
		modifiers = ModifierRunner.ResolveList(packageType.modifiers),
		destinationId = DestinationRegistry.RandomId(rng),
		timeLeft = 0,
	}
	nextId += 1
	return delivery
end

return PackageFactory

-- PlayerData · Coins y stats por jugador EN MEMORIA (S1).
-- DataStore llega en V2 (Plan §4). Al salir del juego, el perfil se descarta.
-- GDD §15: la racha se CUENTA desde ya; el multiplicador de racha llega en S2.
local PlayerData = {}

local profiles = {}

local function newProfile()
	return {
		coins = 0,
		deliveries = 0,
		perfects = 0,
		streak = 0,
		bestStreak = 0,
	}
end

function PlayerData.Get(player)
	if not profiles[player] then
		profiles[player] = newProfile()
	end
	return profiles[player]
end

function PlayerData.AddCoins(player, amount)
	local profile = PlayerData.Get(player)
	profile.coins += amount
	return profile.coins
end

function PlayerData.RecordSuccess(player, wasPerfect)
	local profile = PlayerData.Get(player)
	profile.deliveries += 1
	profile.streak += 1
	if profile.streak > profile.bestStreak then
		profile.bestStreak = profile.streak
	end
	if wasPerfect then
		profile.perfects += 1
	end
end

function PlayerData.RecordFail(player)
	PlayerData.Get(player).streak = 0 -- STREAK LOST (GDD §15)
end

function PlayerData.Clear(player)
	profiles[player] = nil
end

return PlayerData

-- RewardService · Pago de entregas. SOLO servidor: el cliente nunca decide coins.
-- Canon GDD §13: Base + Speed + Perfect. Multiplicador desde PackageTypes (§5).
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Data = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Delivery60"):WaitForChild("Data")
local Config = require(Data:WaitForChild("Config"))
local PackageTypes = require(Data:WaitForChild("PackageTypes"))

local RewardService = {}

function RewardService.Compute(delivery, timeLeft, tookHit)
	local packageType = PackageTypes[delivery.packageType]
	local mult = (packageType and packageType.payMultiplier) or 1
	local breakdown = {
		base = math.floor(Config.BasePay * mult),
		-- [CALIBRAR] Speed Bonus proporcional al tiempo restante (el GDD fija el tope: +50)
		speed = math.floor(Config.SpeedBonusMax * math.max(timeLeft, 0) / Config.DeliveryTimeSeconds),
		perfect = (not tookHit) and Config.PerfectBonus or 0,
	}
	breakdown.total = breakdown.base + breakdown.speed + breakdown.perfect
	return breakdown
end

function RewardService.Consolation()
	-- GDD §38: fallar no castiga → 100 coins de consolación y otra entrega inmediata
	return { base = 0, speed = 0, perfect = 0, consolation = Config.ConsolationPay, total = Config.ConsolationPay }
end

return RewardService

-- DeliveryService · Orquestador del core loop (Script de servidor).
-- UNA máquina de estados POR JUGADOR (Plan §4): mundo persistente, nunca ronda global.
-- IDLE → REVEAL → CARRY → (COMPLETE | FAILED) → IDLE
-- (OFFER queda para V2: en el MVP, usar el prompt del HQ ES aceptar la entrega.)
--
-- Contrato con el cliente (HUD y controlador llegan en cmd_000025/26):
--   DeliveryEvent: "REVEAL" {id, packageType, modifiers, destinationId, destinationName, duration}
--                  "COMPLETE" {breakdown, coins, perfect, timeLeft}
--                  "FAILED" {reason, coins}
--   Atributos del Character: D60_SpeedMultiplier (number), D60_JumpDisabled (bool),
--     D60_Stability (number, solo con Explosive)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Root = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Delivery60")
local Config = require(Root.Data:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Enums = require(Root.Shared:WaitForChild("Enums"))
local DeliveryEvent = Root.Remotes:WaitForChild("DeliveryEvent")

local Modules = script.Parent
local ModifierRunner = require(Modules:WaitForChild("ModifierRunner"))
local DestinationRegistry = require(Modules:WaitForChild("DestinationRegistry"))
local PackageFactory = require(Modules:WaitForChild("PackageFactory"))
local RewardService = require(Modules:WaitForChild("RewardService"))
local PlayerData = require(Modules:WaitForChild("PlayerData"))

local S = Enums.DeliveryState
local R = Enums.DeliveryResult

local HIT_FLOOR_SPEED = 8 -- [CALIBRAR] impacto mínimo (studs/s) que rompe el Perfect (GDD §14)

local PACKAGE_COLORS = {
	Normal = Color3.fromRGB(154, 108, 60),
	Heavy = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 100),
	Explosive = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40),
}

local rng = Random.new()
local sessions = {}
local failDelivery -- declaración anticipada: ctx.fail la usa

local function getSession(player)
	if not sessions[player] then
		sessions[player] = {
			state = S.Idle,
			delivery = nil,
			ctx = nil,
			startedAt = 0,
			lastSpeed = 0,
			packagePart = nil,
			touchConn = nil,
			diedConn = nil,
		}
	end
	return sessions[player]
end

local function applyMovement(player, ctx)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	char:SetAttribute("D60_SpeedMultiplier", ctx.movement.speedMultiplier)
	char:SetAttribute("D60_JumpDisabled", ctx.movement.jumpDisabled)
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum.JumpPower = ctx.movement.jumpDisabled and 0 or 50
	end
end

local function attachPackage(player, delivery)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return nil
	end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return nil
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "DeliveryPackage"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Massless = true
	part.Color = PACKAGE_COLORS[delivery.packageType] or Color3.fromRGB(154, 108, 60)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 1.2)
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 1.2)
	weld.Parent = part
	part.Parent = char
	return part
end

local function cleanupCarry(player)
	local session = getSession(player)
	if session.touchConn then
		session.touchConn:Disconnect()
		session.touchConn = nil
	end
	if session.diedConn then
		session.diedConn:Disconnect()
		session.diedConn = nil
	end
	if session.packagePart then
		session.packagePart:Destroy()
		session.packagePart = nil
	end
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		char:SetAttribute("D60_SpeedMultiplier", 1)
		char:SetAttribute("D60_JumpDisabled", false)
		char:SetAttribute("D60_Stability", nil)
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.JumpPower = 50
		end
	end
end

local function startDelivery(player)
	local session = getSession(player)
	if session.state ~= S.Idle then
		return
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not char or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local delivery = PackageFactory.Create(rng)
	delivery.timeLeft = Config.DeliveryTimeSeconds

	local ctx
	ctx = {
		player = player,
		delivery = delivery,
		movement = { speedMultiplier = 1, jumpDisabled = false },
		state = {},
		fail = function(reason)
			failDelivery(player, reason)
		end,
	}

	session.delivery = delivery
	session.ctx = ctx
	session.state = S.Reveal
	session.startedAt = os.clock()
	session.lastSpeed = 0

	ModifierRunner.Apply(ctx)
	applyMovement(player, ctx)
	session.packagePart = attachPackage(player, delivery)

	-- Colisiones: impacto = velocidad justo antes del contacto (Plan §9-2).
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		session.touchConn = root.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			if session.state ~= S.Carry then
				return
			end
			if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(char) then
				return
			end
			local impact = session.lastSpeed
			if impact >= HIT_FLOOR_SPEED then
				ctx.state.tookHit = true
			end
			ModifierRunner.OnCollide(ctx, hit, impact)
		end)
	end
	session.diedConn = hum.Died:Connect(function()
		failDelivery(player, R.Dropped)
	end)

	local dest = DestinationRegistry.Get(delivery.destinationId)
	session.state = S.Carry
	DeliveryEvent:FireClient(player, "REVEAL", {
		id = delivery.id,
		packageType = delivery.packageType,
		modifiers = delivery.modifiers,
		destinationId = delivery.destinationId,
		destinationName = dest and dest.displayName or delivery.destinationId,
		duration = Config.DeliveryTimeSeconds,
	})
end

local function completeDelivery(player)
	local session = getSession(player)
	if session.state ~= S.Carry or not session.delivery then
		return
	end
	local ctx = session.ctx
	local timeLeft = math.max(0, Config.DeliveryTimeSeconds - (os.clock() - session.startedAt))
	ModifierRunner.OnDeliver(ctx)
	local tookHit = ctx.state.tookHit == true
	local breakdown = RewardService.Compute(session.delivery, timeLeft, tookHit)
	local coins = PlayerData.AddCoins(player, breakdown.total)
	PlayerData.RecordSuccess(player, breakdown.perfect > 0)
	ModifierRunner.Remove(ctx)
	cleanupCarry(player)
	session.state = S.Idle
	session.delivery = nil
	session.ctx = nil
	DeliveryEvent:FireClient(player, "COMPLETE", {
		breakdown = breakdown,
		coins = coins,
		perfect = breakdown.perfect > 0,
		timeLeft = timeLeft,
	})
end

failDelivery = function(player, reason)
	local session = getSession(player)
	if session.state ~= S.Carry and session.state ~= S.Reveal then
		return
	end
	local ctx = session.ctx
	if ctx then
		ModifierRunner.Remove(ctx)
	end
	cleanupCarry(player)
	PlayerData.RecordFail(player) -- STREAK LOST (GDD §15)
	local breakdown = RewardService.Consolation()
	local coins = PlayerData.AddCoins(player, breakdown.total) -- fallar no castiga (GDD §38)
	session.state = S.Idle
	session.delivery = nil
	session.ctx = nil
	DeliveryEvent:FireClient(player, "FAILED", { reason = reason, coins = coins })
end

-- Prompts: HQ ("PickupPrompt") inicia; marcadores ("DeliveryPrompt") entregan.
local cityRoot = workspace:WaitForChild("Delivery60")

ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, player)
	if not prompt:IsDescendantOf(cityRoot) then
		return
	end
	if prompt.Name == "PickupPrompt" then
		startDelivery(player)
	elseif prompt.Name == "DeliveryPrompt" then
		local session = getSession(player)
		if session.state ~= S.Carry or not session.delivery then
			return
		end
		local marker = prompt.Parent
		if marker and marker.Name == session.delivery.destinationId .. "_Marker" then
			completeDelivery(player)
		end
	end
end)

-- Bucle único de entregas activas: temporizador, tick de modificadores y
-- medición de velocidad para el cálculo de impactos.
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for player, session in pairs(sessions) do
		if session.state == S.Carry and session.delivery then
			local char = player.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				session.lastSpeed = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			end
			ModifierRunner.Tick(session.ctx, dt)
			if session.ctx and session.ctx.state.stability ~= nil and char then
				char:SetAttribute("D60_Stability", math.floor(session.ctx.state.stability))
			end
			if session.delivery and os.clock() - session.startedAt >= Config.DeliveryTimeSeconds then
				failDelivery(player, R.Timeout)
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local session = sessions[player]
	if session and (session.state == S.Carry or session.state == S.Reveal) then
		cleanupCarry(player)
	end
	sessions[player] = nil
	PlayerData.Clear(player)
end)

print("[Delivery60] DeliveryService listo · S1")
